rules: :root { --gutter: clamp(16px, 4vw, 48px); --measure: 66ch; --container: 1280px; --masthead-rule: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); }
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 17px/1.6 var(--sans); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; }
main, article { min-width: 0; }
a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
img { max-width: 100%; }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
h1, h2, h3, p { margin: 0; }
.site-shell { display: flex; min-height: 100vh; flex-direction: column; }
.container { width: min(var(--container), calc(100% - var(--gutter) * 2)); margin-inline: auto; }
.category { display: inline-block; color: var(--accent); font: 700 12px/1.2 var(--sans); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
a.category:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.meta, .post-date { color: var(--meta); font: 12px/1.4 var(--sans); }
.meta a { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
.post-image-placeholder { position: relative; min-height: 1px; background: var(--wash) repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 10px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.035) 10px 11px); }
.post-image-placeholder::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 1px solid var(--rule-soft); }
.site-header { width: 100%; background: var(--masthead); color: var(--masthead-ink); }
header.site-header a { color: var(--masthead-ink); }
.topbar { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--masthead-rule); }
.topbar-inner { display: flex; min-height: 36px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; color: var(--masthead-muted); font: 12px/1.4 var(--sans); }
.topbar-date { display: inline-flex; min-width: 0; align-items: center; gap: 8px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

.topbar-date::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, transparent); animation: pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
.topbar-nav, .main-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.topbar-nav { flex: none; gap: 22px; white-space: nowrap; }
.topbar-nav a { color: var(--masthead-muted); transition: color 160ms ease; }
.topbar-nav a:hover { color: var(--masthead-ink); }
.main-header { padding: 0; }
.main-header-inner { display: flex; min-height: 84px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 32px; }
.brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; color: var(--masthead-ink); font: 900 clamp(26px, 3.4vw, 40px)/0.95 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.045em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.brand::before { content: ''; flex: none; width: 12px; height: 1em; background: var(--accent); }
.brand:hover { color: var(--masthead-ink); }
.masthead-search { display: flex; flex: 0 1 320px; min-width: 0; }

.masthead-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--masthead-rule); border-right: 0; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); color: var(--masthead-ink); font: 14px/1 var(--sans); }
.masthead-search input::placeholder { color: var(--masthead-muted); }
.masthead-search input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--masthead-ink); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); }

.masthead-search button { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font: 700 12px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; }
.masthead-search button:hover { filter: brightness(1.12); }
.section-nav { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border-top: 4px solid var(--accent); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.section-nav-inner { display: flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: stretch; justify-content: flex-start; }
.main-nav { gap: clamp(18px, 2.4vw, 32px); white-space: nowrap; }

.main-nav a, .site-header .main-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 48px; color: var(--ink); font: 700 13px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }

.main-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 4px; background: var(--accent); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 200ms ease; }
.main-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.main-nav a:hover::after, .main-nav a[aria-current='page']::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
.nav-search, .site-header .main-nav .nav-search { margin-left: auto; color: var(--meta); }
.content-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 300px; gap: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 48px); padding-top: clamp(20px, 2.6vw, 32px); flex: 1; }
.primary { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: clamp(28px, 3vw, 40px); }

.lead { display: grid; max-width: none; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.55fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: clamp(20px, 2.6vw, 36px); align-items: center; padding-bottom: clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); animation: rise 520ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) both; }
.lead:has(.post-image-placeholder) { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
.lead .post-image-placeholder { display: none; }
.lead-figure { display: block; order: -1; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: var(--wash); }
.lead-figure img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 600ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); }
.lead-figure:hover img { transform: scale(1.025); }
.lead-copy { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.lead-title { color: var(--ink); font: 800 clamp(28px, 3.1vw, 42px)/1.06 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.03em; }
.lead-title a { background-image: linear-gradient(var(--ink), var(--ink)); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: 0 3px; background-position: 0 100%; transition: background-size 260ms ease; }
.lead-title a:hover { color: var(--ink); background-size: 100% 3px; }
.lead-excerpt { max-width: 56ch; color: var(--body); font-size: clamp(16px, 1.25vw, 18px); line-height: 1.5; }
.section-heading { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 20px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 4px solid var(--ink); }
.section-heading :is(h1, h2) { color: var(--ink); font: 800 clamp(20px, 1.8vw, 24px)/1.1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.section-heading > a { color: var(--meta); font: 700 12px/1.2 var(--sans); letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }
.section-heading > a::after { content: ' →'; }
.feed-section, .index-section { padding-top: 0; }
.post-list { display: grid; gap: 28px; }
.post-list[data-variant='grid'] { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 32px 0; margin-inline: -16px; }
.post-list[data-variant='grid'] .post-card { padding-inline: 16px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.post-list[data-variant='grid'] .post-card:nth-child(4n + 1) { border-left: 0; }
.post-card { display: flex; max-width: none; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; animation: rise 520ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) both; }
.post-card:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 60ms; }
.post-card:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 120ms; }
.post-card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 180ms; }
.post-card:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 240ms; }
.post-card:nth-child(n + 5) { animation-delay: 300ms; }
.post-image { display: block; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: var(--wash); }
.post-image img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); }
.post-card:hover .post-image img { transform: scale(1.04); }
.post-copy { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; }
.post-title { color: var(--ink); font: 700 18px/1.25 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.015em; }
.post-title a:hover { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.excerpt { color: var(--body); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; }
.post-list[data-variant='grid'] .excerpt { display: none; }
.post-list[data-variant='list'] { gap: 0; }
.post-list[data-variant='list'] .post-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 240px; gap: 24px; padding: 24px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.post-list[data-variant='list'] .post-card:first-child { padding-top: 0; }
.post-list[data-variant='list'] .post-card:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.post-list[data-variant='list'] .post-image { order: 2; align-self: start; }
.post-list[data-variant='list'] .post-title { font-size: 22px; }
.feed-end { margin-top: 24px; color: var(--meta); font: 12px/1.4 var(--sans); text-align: center; }
.feed-sentinel { height: 1px; }

.pagination { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-top: 32px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); font: 700 12px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }

.pagination a, .pagination strong, .pagination span { display: inline-flex; min-width: 36px; height: 36px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding-inline: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--body); }
.pagination a:hover { border-color: var(--ink); color: var(--ink); }
.pagination strong { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
.pagination > span { color: var(--rule); }
.pagination-numbers { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.sidebar, .editorial-rail { display: flex; min-width: 0; margin-top: 0; padding-top: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 32px; border-top: 0; }
.sidebar h2, .editorial-rail h2 { padding-top: 10px; border-top: 4px solid var(--ink); color: var(--ink); font: 800 18px/1.1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.sidebar ul, .sidebar ol, .editorial-rail ul, .editorial-rail ol { display: flex; margin: 0; padding: 0; flex-direction: column; list-style: none; }
.rail-list { counter-reset: rail; }
.rail-list li { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 10px; padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); counter-increment: rail; }
.rail-list li::before { content: counter(rail); grid-row: 1 / span 2; color: var(--accent); font: 800 30px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.04em; }
.rail-list li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.rail-list a { color: var(--ink); font: 700 16px/1.3 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.rail-list a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.rail-stamp { grid-column: 2; order: 2; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--meta); font: 12px/1.3 var(--sans); }
.archive-list li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.archive-list li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.archive-list a { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 11px 0; color: var(--body); font: 500 14px/1.3 var(--sans); }
.archive-list a:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.archive-count { min-width: 26px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--wash); color: var(--meta); font: 700 11px/1.4 var(--sans); text-align: center; }
.sidebar-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }

.sidebar-tags a, .article-tags a { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink); font: 700 12px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; }
.sidebar-tags a:hover, .article-tags a:hover { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
.sidebar-empty, .comments-empty { color: var(--meta); font: 14px/1.5 var(--sans); }
.field-row { display: flex; gap: 0; }
input[type='search'], input[name='q'] { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 42px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 15px/1 var(--sans); }
input::placeholder { color: var(--meta); }
input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ink); }

button[type='submit'] { height: 42px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 700 12px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; }
button[type='submit']:hover { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.post-body { width: min(1100px, calc(100% - var(--gutter) * 2)); margin-inline: auto; padding-top: clamp(24px, 3vw, 40px); flex: 1; }
.article-head { display: flex; max-width: 700px; margin-inline: auto; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; animation: rise 520ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) both; }
.breadcrumb { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--meta); font: 12px/1.4 var(--sans); }
.breadcrumb a:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.post-body h1 { color: var(--ink); font: 800 clamp(30px, 4.2vw, 52px)/1.04 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.035em; }
.standfirst { color: var(--body); font: 400 clamp(18px, 1.5vw, 21px)/1.45 var(--sans); }

.byline { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 12px; padding: 14px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--meta); font: 13px/1.4 var(--sans); }
.byline a { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
.byline a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }

.byline-avatar { display: inline-grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 800 14px/1 var(--sans); text-transform: uppercase; }
.updated-time { color: var(--meta); }
.article-figure { max-width: 1000px; margin: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px) auto 0; }
.article-figure img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; object-fit: cover; background: var(--wash); }
.article-figure figcaption { padding: 10px 0 0; color: var(--meta); font: 12px/1.5 var(--sans); }
.prose { max-width: 700px; margin: clamp(28px, 3vw, 40px) auto 0; color: var(--prose); font: 19px/1.75 var(--serif); }
.prose > * + * { margin-top: 22px; }
.prose > p:first-child { color: var(--ink); font: 700 20px/1.5 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.prose h2, .prose h3 { margin-top: 40px; color: var(--ink); font: 800 26px/1.2 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.prose h3 { font-size: 21px; }
.prose img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; margin: 28px 0; }
.prose figure { margin: 32px 0; }
.prose figcaption { margin-top: 8px; color: var(--meta); font: 12px/1.5 var(--sans); }
.prose a { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--accent); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.prose a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
.prose blockquote { margin: 32px 0; padding: 4px 0 4px 24px; border-left: 4px solid var(--accent); color: var(--ink); font: 700 24px/1.35 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.prose blockquote p + p { margin-top: 12px; }
.prose ul, .prose ol { padding-left: 22px; }
.prose li + li { margin-top: 8px; }
.prose pre, .prose code { font-size: 0.9em; }
.article-tags { display: flex; max-width: 700px; margin: 32px auto 0; padding-top: 22px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.article-related { max-width: 700px; margin: 36px auto 0; padding-top: 0; border-top: 0; }
.article-related h2 { padding-top: 10px; border-top: 4px solid var(--ink); color: var(--ink); font: 800 18px/1.1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.article-related p { margin-top: 12px; font: 15px/1.5 var(--sans); }
.article-related a { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
.article-related .rail-list { counter-reset: rail; margin-top: 4px; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.plugin-slot { max-width: 700px; margin: 28px auto 0; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--meta); font: 13px/1.5 var(--sans); }
.plugin-slot p { margin: 0; }

.post-body > small { display: block; max-width: 700px; margin: 36px auto 0; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--meta); font: 11px/1.5 var(--sans); word-break: break-all; }
.post-body > p, .post-body > ul { max-width: var(--measure); margin-top: 16px; color: var(--prose); font: 18px/1.7 var(--serif); }
.post-body > ul { padding-left: 20px; }

.post-body > a { display: inline-block; margin-top: 20px; padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 700 12px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.post-body > a:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.post-body label { display: block; margin: 20px 0 10px; color: var(--meta); font: 700 12px/1.2 var(--sans); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.post-body input[type='search'] { width: min(420px, 100%); }
.post-body [aria-live] { margin-top: 14px; color: var(--meta); font: 12px/1.4 var(--sans); }
.post-body .post-list { margin-top: 24px; }
.author-profile { padding-top: clamp(24px, 3vw, 40px); }
.author-profile h1 { margin: 10px 0 12px; color: var(--ink); font: 800 clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 44px)/1.05 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.03em; }
.author-profile p:last-child { max-width: 60ch; color: var(--body); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.55; }
.comments { max-width: 700px; margin: 48px auto 0; padding-top: 24px; border-top: 4px solid var(--ink); font-family: var(--sans); }
.comments h2 { margin-bottom: 14px; color: var(--ink); font: 800 22px/1.1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.comments [data-comment-status] { color: var(--meta); font-size: 14px; }
.comment-list { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.comment-list li { padding: 16px 18px; border-left: 3px solid var(--rule); background: var(--wash); }
.comment-list li strong { display: block; color: var(--ink); font-size: 14px; }
.comment-list p { margin-top: 6px; color: var(--prose); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; }
.comment-form { display: grid; gap: 14px; margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.comment-form label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); font: 700 13px/1.3 var(--sans); }
.comment-form input, .comment-form textarea { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--paper); color: var(--prose); font: 15px/1.5 var(--sans); }
.comment-form input:focus, .comment-form textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ink); }
.comment-form textarea { min-height: 120px; resize: vertical; }
.comment-form button[type='submit'] { justify-self: start; }
.comment-form button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.55; }
.comment-verification-note, [data-comment-submit-status], [data-human-verification-status] { color: var(--meta); font: 13px/1.5 var(--sans); }
.site-footer { margin-top: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px); background: var(--masthead); color: var(--masthead-ink); }
.site-footer a { color: var(--masthead-ink); }
.footer-main { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 32px; padding: 40px 0 32px; }

.footer-main[data-brand]::before { content: attr(data-brand); grid-column: 1; color: var(--masthead-ink); font: 900 clamp(22px, 2.4vw, 30px)/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.footer-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.footer-col h2 { margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--masthead-muted); font: 700 11px/1.2 var(--sans); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.footer-col a, .footer-col span { color: var(--masthead-ink); font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--sans); }
.footer-col a:hover { color: var(--masthead-muted); }

.footer-bar-inner { display: flex; min-height: 56px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--masthead-rule); color: var(--masthead-muted); font: 12px/1.4 var(--sans); }
.to-top { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.to-top:hover { color: var(--masthead-muted); }
@keyframes rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
@keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, transparent); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent); } }

@media (max-width: 1100px) { .post-list[data-variant='grid'] { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .post-list[data-variant='grid'] .post-card:nth-child(n) { padding-inline: 16px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); } .post-list[data-variant='grid'] .post-card:nth-child(3n + 1) { border-left: 0; } }

@media (max-width: 1000px) { .content-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .editorial-rail, .sidebar { padding-top: 32px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); } .lead { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: start; } .lead-title { font-size: clamp(28px, 4.6vw, 40px); } .footer-main { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr)); } .footer-main[data-brand]::before { grid-column: 1 / -1; } }
